subject.title: Race condition (missing tool result / synthetic errors) still reproducible on 2026.6.11 AND 2026.7.1-beta.2 — supersedes closed #31664/#6682/#15008/#13286

question: Should maintainers require redacted Feishu or comparable long-running production-runner proof before accepting https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97646 or a successor as the fix for this issue?
rationale: The source boundary and focused tests line up with the report, but the reported failure is a long-running production race and the active PR is still explicitly proof-gated.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu, channel, or runner logs showing real tool results persist without synthetic missing-result entries before landing the candidate fix.

options.title: Accept focused source/test proof
options.body: Maintainers can choose to land based on shared-helper source and regression-test evidence while owning the remaining production-path uncertainty.

options.title: Wait for live reproduction first
options.body: Hold the issue as needs-live-repro until a maintainer or reporter supplies a redacted long-session trajectory excerpt or Crabbox-like reproduction.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Feishu, channel, or runner logs showing real tool results persist without synthetic missing-result entries before landing the candidate fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The central session guard behavior and the wait-for-idle mitigation both route through this history, making this the best available proof-sufficiency owner.
